answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A onyx of per-task receipts records who did what, and the garden of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the forge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
